newsitem.title: USA: Cuban exile planes fly to commemorate shootdown.
newsitem.headline: Cuban exile planes fly to commemorate shootdown.

text.p: Seven Cuban exile planes left Miami on Monday to drop wreaths and flowers over the site in the Florida Strait where Cuban MiG jets shot down two aircraft a year ago.

The planes took off after an emotional memorial service at Opa-Locka airfield for the four people killed in the attack. Cuban Americans opposed to President Fidel Castro have declared the anniversary a "Day of Sorrow and Hope."
